newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan Tamil rebels kill 15 policemen in raid.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan Tamil rebels kill 15 policemen in raid.

text.p: Tamil Tiger guerrillas attacked a police post in northeastern Sri Lanka early on Tuesday killing at least 15 policemen, military and police officials said.

At least 10 policemen were wounded in the attack by Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels on the police post in the Polonnaruwa district, 200 km (125 miles) from the capital Colombo, they said.
A Defence Ministry spokesman confirmed the rebel attack on the Sungawila police post but could not immediately give details.
It was not clear if there were any casualties among the rebels, who are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the Indian Ocean island's north and east.
